 Analysis
 An undefeated Wyoming team travels to face undefeated UNLV, with the simulation clearly favoring the home side. The difference comes down to volume: UNLV's Jackson Arnold projects for 170 passing yards against Wyoming's Tyler Hughes at 160, while Jai'Den Thomas is expected to add 65 rushing yards to a Rebels offense that should generate more total opportunities. When AccuScore has leaned this strongly toward one side in past games of similar shape, that side won 66 percent of the time. Wyoming would need to limit UNLV's yardage advantage and convert their fewer offensive touches into points to pull the upset.
